'''Gaidin''' is a horse owned by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].

==Appearance==
Gaidin is a black stallion.

==Activities==
When Nynaeve al'Meara, [[Egwene al'Vere]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] escape from the brigands on their way to [[Tear]], they take horses to help them on their journey. Nynaeve chooses a black stallion and names him Gaidin, in honor of [[Lan Mandragoran]].{{ref/book|3|39}} Gaidin carries Nynaeve while she is in Tear.{{ref/book|3|48}}
